senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Of a tawny colour.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Tawny, (the colour.)
2 A rat.
n. (-ङ्गं)
A young animal.
f. (-ङ्गा)
1 A yellow dye: see गोरोचना.
2 Asafoetida.
3 A tubular vessel of the body, which according to the Yoga system, is the channel of respiration and circulation for one side.
4 A name of DURGĀ.
5 Turmerick.
6 Bambu manna.
(-ङ्गी)
A sort of Mimosa, (M. suma, Rox.)
E.
पिजि to colour, aff. अच्; or पिङ्ग tawny, aff. टाप्, &c.

f. (-शा)
A cockroach.
E.
पिङ्ग tawny, and कपिश brown.

m. (-क्षुः)
A crab.
E.
पिङ्ग tawny, and चक्षुस् the eye.

m. (-टः)
ŚIVA.
E.
पिङ्ग tawny, and जटा braided hair.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a tawny colour, brown, yellowish.
m. (-लः)
1 Tawny, (the colour,) a dull brown, or yellow.
2 An attendant upon the sun.
3 The sun.
4 A fabulous being in the form of a Nāga, or serpent of the lower regions, to whom a treatise on prosody is ascribed; he is hence considered as a Muni, or inspired and divine personage.
5 A name of ŚIVA.
6 One of KUVERA'S divine treasures.
7 A monkey.
8 Fire.
9 An ichneumon.
10 A sort of poison.
11 A small owl.
12 The 51st year of the Hindū cycle.
n. (-लं)
1 Brass.
2 Yellow orpiment.
f. (-ला)
1 The female elephant of the south quarter.
2 A pious whore, commemorated in the Bhāgavata.
3 A particular vessel of the body, the right of three canals which run from the os-coccygis to the head, and which are the chief passages of breath and air, according to the anatomy of the Yoga school of philosophy.
4 An astrological house or period.
5 The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
6 Heartpea.
E.
पिजि to colour, Uṇādi aff. अलच्; or पिङ्गल of a tawny hue, fem. aff. टाप्.

f. (-का)
A sort of crane: see वलाक.
E.
पिङ्गल of a tawny colour, कन् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
पिङ्ग reddish brown, and अक्ष an eye.

m. (-शः)
1 A sort of fish, (Pimelodius pangasius, HAM.)
2 The head man or proprietor of a village.
n. (-शं)
Virgin gold.
f. (-शी)
The indigo plant.
E.
पिङ्ग tawny, आश flesh, from अश to eat, aff. अण्.

m. (-स्यः)
A fish: see the last.

m. (-णः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
पिङ्ग tawny, and ईक्षण eye.
